app.name: mise
page.recipes.title: Recipes
page.plan.title: This week
page.groceries.title: Groceries
page.settings.title: Settings
page.placeholder.body: Nothing here yet. This part of mise is still being built.
error.notFound.title: Page not found
error.notFound.body: The page you were looking for doesn't exist.
error.internal.title: Something went wrong
error.internal.body: Please try again in a moment.
auth.panel.headline: Recipes, plan and groceries in one place.
auth.panel.sub: Self-hosted, so your data stays on your server.
signin.title: Sign in
signin.lead: Sign in to get to your recipes, plan and lists.
signin.leadWide: Welcome back. Sign in to continue.
signin.newHere: New here? Ask someone in your household for an invite link.
signin.error.invalid: That username and password don't match. Check both and try again.
signin.error.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.askAdmin.title: Ask an admin
forgot.askAdmin.body: mise can't send emails yet. Ask an admin in your household to set a new password for you in Settings → People.
setup.title: Set up mise
setup.lead: Create your household and the first admin account. You can invite everyone else afterwards.
setup.panel.headline: Everything in its place, starting now.
setup.panel.sub: This runs once. The household you create here is where recipes, the plan and lists live.
setup.timezoneHint: An IANA name like Europe/Vienna. Days and weeks follow this zone.
setup.baseURLHint: The address people use to reach mise. Invite links start with it.
field.name: Name
field.usernameHint: Letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores. Not case-sensitive.
form.error.email: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
form.error.timezone: Use a time zone name like Europe/Vienna.
form.error.baseURL: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://.
form.error.usernameChars: Use only letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores.
accept.title: Create your account
accept.share: You'll share recipes, the plan and lists in %s.
accept.panel.headline: Cook from the same recipes, plan and list.
accept.invalid.title: This invite doesn't work
accept.invalid.body: The link has expired, was revoked or was already used. Ask for a new one.
settings.peopleNote: Everyone shares the same recipes, plan and lists.
account.title: Account
account.visibleNote: Others see your name and initial next to items and recipes you add.
account.passwordOthersSignedOut: Your other devices are signed out when you change it.
account.deleteNote: To delete your account, ask an admin. Recipes you added stay for everyone else.
invite.title: Invite someone
invite.lead: They'll share your recipes, plan and lists.
invite.emailHint: To remember who the link is for. mise doesn't send emails yet.
invite.expiry: Invites expire after 7 days and work once.
invite.linkHint: Send this link yourself. It's shown only once, expires after 7 days and works once.
member.isYou: This is you. Change your own name and password on your account page.
member.resetHint: Tell %s the new password. Their devices are signed out.
member.removeBody: %s can no longer sign in. Recipes and items they added stay.
member.error.lastAdmin: The household needs at least one admin. Make someone else admin first.
member.error.self: You can't do that to your own account.
member.error.sharedAccount: This account also belongs to another household, so only its owner can change the password.
notice.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other devices are signed out.
notice.othersSignedOut: Your other devices are signed out.
error.forbidden.title: Admins only
error.forbidden.body: Only admins of your household can open this page.
groceries.empty.title: All done
groceries.empty.body: Nothing left to buy. Add what you need below, or start from things you buy often.
groceries.gone.title: This list was deleted
groceries.gone.body: Someone in your household deleted it. Your other lists are still there.
groceries.suggest.amountNote: picked up from what you typed
groceries.suggest.keys: ↑ ↓ to choose · Enter to add · Esc to close
groceries.toast.gone: That item is no longer on the list.
groceries.edit.title: Edit %s
groceries.edit.categoryHint: Remembered for next time you add %s.
groceries.edit.newCategoryHint: Creates the category and puts the item in it.
groceries.edit.renameHint: Renames the item everywhere it's used.
groceries.clear.title: Clear the cart?
groceries.clear.body: %s is shared, so these checked items disappear for everyone. Items still to get stay on the list.
groceries.clear.note: They'll come back as suggestions under Usually bought.
groceries.error.categoryExists: There's already a category with that name.
groceries.error.itemExists: There's already an item with that name.
groceries.error.lastList: Keep at least one list. Create another before deleting this one.
settings.listsNote: The first list opens by default.
notice.categoryDeleted: Category deleted. Its items are uncategorised now.
categories.title: Categories & aisles
categories.lead: Groceries are sorted in this order. Match the way you walk through your usual shop.
categories.dragHint: Drag a row, or use the arrows.
categories.deleteNote: Its items become uncategorised. Lists keep them.
categories.footer: Changes apply to every list, for everyone.
